summary.text: Linda Adamo is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Strafford 3, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Susan DeRoy.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as educator and administrator.

paragraphs.text: Adamo earned a high school diploma from Wellington C. Mepham High School and an associate degree from Queensborough Community College in 1972, according to Ballotpedia.
Her career experience includes work as an educator and administrator.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Adamo said she wants to bring her governmental experience in Middleton to the state.
She said public education needs more state funding, that zoning and planning control should return to the towns, and that natural resources and renewable energy deserve attention.
